Repaint this same single game enemy portrait with a much cleaner, stronger hand-drawn ink-and-opaque-paint illustration style. Crisp edges and intentional strokes, NOT blurred denoising, NOT realistic 3D, NOT airbrushed plastic, NOT vector-perfect geometric tracing. Flat uniform pure #FF00FF magenta backdrop and empty gaps, no scenery, no ground shadow, no labels, no text, no watermark. This image should visibly feel simpler and more hand-drawn than the source.
